messages:
mia: Quick heads-up — planning a micro-webinar + 50 free-credit onboarding nudge to push signups to first 10 requests. Goal: reduce time-to-first-use and lift 7-day activation by +10% :rocket:

sam: sounds good. target cohort? new signups only or re-engage cold leads?

mia: new signups only (created <=14d). exclude enterprise trial invites.

jordan: creative plan: two launch posts for social + one longform benchmark thread. Variant A = 'benchmark narrative' (latency/cost win for platform teams). Variant B = 'starter prompts' (prompt templates + credits). I'll prepare hero images for both.

lia: product ask — need a short walkthrough for the micro-webinar: 10 min demo, 5 min Q&A, CTA = claim credits + try prompt pack. Can we have the prompt templates baked into the registration confirmation email?

mia: yes — registration email will include the prompt pack link and a single-click CTA to claim credits.

alex: routing/ops note — to prevent fraud we'll gate credits with SMS verify or credit cap. Proposed rule in routing service:
```
if signup.age_days <= 14 and signup.verified_email == true:
  grant_credits(user_id, amount=50, label='micro-webinar')
else:
  do_not_grant
```
We'll also set a 72h TTL on the claim link.

sam: tracking KPI list: first-10-requests conversion, time-to-first-request, tokens-used in first 24h, retention at day 7. Also log variant tag (A/B post + webinar).

tess: copy for post variants: I'll drop microcopy + 3 headline options in #marketing-assets by tomorrow. Need comms for support on known issues (rate limits, model mismatch).

jordan: benchmark narrative draft: short hero stat + 3 mini case bullets (startup using caching -> 40% token cost reduction, enterprise latency SLO hit at 95th perc). I'll avoid heavy numbers, keep Dev ROI language.

mia: webinar logistics: Tue 11am PT, 30 seats live (low friction), recording to hub. Can we route registrants who don't attend into a 3-email nurture over 7 days with a smaller credit (20) on final email?

alex: yes — automation: no-show -> drip-nurture-3 -> final-email grants 20 credits if link clicked. We'll tag those users for paid outreach only if they hit first-10-requests.

lia: onboarding flow tweak: after they claim credits + run a prompt from the pack, show an inline checklist: 1) try 3 prompts 2) pin favorite 3) save prompt template. That checklist will emit metric events for analytics.

sam: can we A/B test the nudge copy? Hard nudge vs soft nudge. A = "Claim 50 credits — try these templates" B = "Explore starter prompts (free credits included)". We'll split 50/50 on the landing.

mia: agree. also want a small experiment on routing: variant X routes to quickstart lab (interactive sandbox), variant Y to recorded demo first. Measure time-to-first-request.

growth-bot: FYI — created cohort "microwebinar_4520001111" and added 0 current members. Use cohort tag in tracking.

alex: ops checklist for launch: issue feature-flag for credits, add rate-limit guard, create TTL links, connect segment event names, set rollback if fraudulent claims >1% within hour.

tess: will prepare support FAQ and canned replies for common questions (how credits work, expiration, why I don't see templates).

mia: publish plan: social posts go live Mon 9am PT, webinar Tue 11am PT, email drip starts Wed for no-shows. Jordan/Tess/Sam — can we review assets Mon AM?

jordan: booked review 9:30am PT Mon.

sam: I'll wire up analytics and dashboard for KPIs (first-10 conversion + cohort) by Monday EOD.

mia: perfect. last note — benchmark narrative should be light on numbers but include 1 concrete example headline for web copy. Keep the CTA focused on "Try with 50 free credits" :white_check_mark:

lia: moving to implementation. ping me if we need product flags changed.

alex: ops ready for rollout.

tess: draft copy will be in #marketing-assets by 5pm today.

mia: thanks everyone — let's aim to ship with minimal friction and iterate based on early signal. react with :rocket: when you can take ownership of your item.
